prompt: Looking almost straight down from high in a schooner's rigging at night, 18mm lens, the masts converging to a point far below. A barrel-chested Portuguese American of about 60 clings to the ropes just under the lens, face tipped up and square to us, looking just above the camera: heavy single brow, big jug ears, bulbous nose, deep-cut jowls, white stubble, tweed cap pushed back, missing eye tooth. His face fills a third of the frame, ropes running beside it and never across it. Far beneath his shoulders, sacks of bottles swing out over the side toward two small motorboats with red lamps on violet water. A hanging yellow lamp beside the lens lights his whole face. Dark sea fills all the corners, nothing written on anything. Thanks.
